reasoning: Factor the odd modulus and count roots modulo each prime power, multiplying by CRT. For nonzero B, its p-adic valuation must be divisible by A. Removing this valuation leaves an equation in the cyclic unit group, with gcd(A,phi) roots iff B^(phi/gcd)=1. Account for free lifts by p^(valuation-rootvaluation). If B vanishes modulo the prime power, count roots whose valuation is at least ceil(e/A).
